canonical_project: Thanh Hoa IT building / provincial data center project
notes: VietnamNet reports the 334 billion VND, 12-storey Thanh Hoa IT building (started Sep 2019, >90% complete by Feb 2021) is designated to house the provincial data center, network/cybersecurity center and smart-city operations center (IOC); a 2023 plan further targets data-center and cloud infrastructure for 2023-2025. No MW disclosed.
